image_description: A low-angle shot of a street sign assembly against a deep blue sky. The primary feature is a curved, dark metal archway with white lettering that appears distorted and partially illegible (resembling 'AVOC...'). Below this arch is a rectangular green panel, largely obscured or blank. At the bottom is a weathered, rounded rectangular sign with large, stylized white characters on a distressed background. The signs are mounted on dark vertical posts.

artifact_observations.location: Top curved arch and bottom rounded sign
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text is completely nonsensical. Characters are malformed, merged, and spatially inconsistent. This is a hallmark AI artifact where the model mimics the shape of text without understanding orthography.
The physical attachment mechanism is missing or implausible. The signs appear to float or fuse into the posts without visible bolts, brackets, or welds, violating physical structural logic.
The texture is unevenly distributed, with some areas looking like clean vector graphics and others like noisy, eroded paint. It lacks the consistent material properties of real-world signage.
The curvature and thickness of the arch change inconsistently along its length, suggesting a warping of 3D geometry rather than a rigid object viewed from an angle.
